display.purpose: Uppercase Archivo black document titles; accent words in Kaşe Violet.

body.purpose: Article and description copy; Pencil Gray inside panels, Ink on open paper.

label.purpose: Courier Prime uppercase micro-labels: serials, form labels, document-type markers.

shadows.name: doc
shadows.purpose: The single resting shadow under lifted document sheets; never animated, never stacked.

motion.name: stamp-press
motion.purpose: Kaşe stamps press into the paper on first view; static under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Service ribbon under the hero; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Action Stamp (red)
components.description: The one red per viewport: the conversion action as a double-ring red stamp.
components.css: .ds-btn-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--color-action, #c8341f); color: var(--color-paper, #f6f4ec); border: 2.5px solid var(--color-action, #c8341f); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-paper, #f6f4ec); padding: 12px 24px; font-family: var(--font-archivo), Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; transition: filter 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-action:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-action:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #14162b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Action Stamp (ink)
components.description: Secondary ink stamp for non-conversion actions (navbar CTA, GERİ DÖN).
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #14162b); border: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #14162b); padding: 12px 24px; font-family: var(--font-archivo), Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background: var(--color-ink, #14162b); color: var(--color-paper, #f6f4ec); } .ds-btn-ink:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #14162b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ledger Row
components.description: Label → dotted leader → mono tabular value; the only way numbers appear.
components.css: .ds-ledger { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(20, 22, 43, 0.2); } .ds-ledger-label { font-family: var(--font-archivo), Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-pencil, #6f6a60); } .ds-ledger-dots { flex: 1 1 0%; min-width: 24px; height: 3px; background-image: radial-gradient(circle, currentColor 1px, transparent 1.4px); background-size: 7px 3px; background-repeat: repeat-x; opacity: 0.45; color: var(--color-ink, #14162b); } .ds-ledger-value { font-family: var(--font-courier), 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-ink, #14162b); }

components.name: Serial Strip
components.description: Document header: serial number, dotted leader, document-type marker.
components.css: .ds-serial { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; font-family: var(--font-courier), 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-pencil, #6f6a60); } .ds-serial strong { color: var(--color-ink, #14162b); letter-spacing: 0.14em; } .ds-serial-dots { flex: 1 1 0%; min-width: 24px; height: 3px; background-image: radial-gradient(circle, currentColor 1px, transparent 1.4px); background-size: 7px 3px; background-repeat: repeat-x; opacity: 0.45; }

components.name: Ruled Input
components.description: Form field as a ruled line: dashed ink underline at rest, solid on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field span { display: block; font-family: var(--font-courier), 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-ink, #14162b); margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--color-ink, #14162b); padding: 8px 0; font-family: var(--font-archivo), Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: var(--color-ink, #14162b); border-radius: 0; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--color-pencil, #6f6a60); } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #14162b); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #14162b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Service Tag
components.description: Mono uppercase tag for categories and service labels.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: var(--color-paper, #f6f4ec); color: var(--color-ink, #14162b); border: 1px solid rgba(20, 22, 43, 0.4); border-radius: 3px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: var(--font-courier), 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Kaşe Stamp
components.description: Double-ring pressed-ink verification stamp; decorative, aria-hidden.
components.css: .ds-kase { width: 160px; height: 160px; transform: rotate(-8deg); color: var(--color-kase, #4340b0); mix-blend-mode: multiply; -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(circle, black 92%, transparent 96%); mask-image: radial-gradient(circle, black 92%, transparent 96%); } .ds-kase svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }

narrative.northStar: Fatura & Kaşe — every claim is a certified document
narrative.overview: The site is the agency's official paperwork. Each page is one document with a type, a serial strip, ruled sections, verification stamps, and a signature. The visitor reads a result certificate, trusts numbers entered like a ledger, and signs the quote request. The dark-hero-and-gradient agency look this replaced is the standing anti-reference.
keyCharacteristics: Ledger rows carry every number (label → dotted leader → mono tabular value)
Kaşe stamps read as pressed ink, never as badges
Exactly one red element per viewport: the action stamp
Sections tear apart along perforation dividers on alternating paper grounds

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red is a permission, not a color: one red element per viewport, and it is always the conversion action.

rules.name: The Remap Rule
rules.body: Accent spans arriving from CMS content render as Kaşe Violet via globals.css; copy is never edited to match the palette.

rules.name: The Turkish Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase display text relies on lang="tr" for correct i→İ; never hand-upcase Turkish strings.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; the single --shadow-doc appears only where a physical sheet sits on the page.

dos: Do open every new template with a SerialStrip and a document-type label.
Do set every number as a ledger row: label → dots-leader → Courier Prime tabular value.
Do keep stamps pressed: .kase-ink mask, multiply blend, double ring, slight rotation.
Do alternate section grounds paper / paper-alt and separate them with PerforationDivider.
Do keep one red per viewport and make it the conversion action.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glassmorphism, dark section grounds, or rounded-2xl SaaS cards.
Don't use a serif display face, terracotta accents, or any red that is not the action stamp.
Don't add entrance animations that hide content; motion is press/tear feedback only.
Don't add decorative kickers/eyebrows; mono labels must name a real thing on the document.
Don't edit CMS copy to fit the palette; extend the Remap Rule instead.
